name: @a-identity/trust-mcp

tools.name: check_before_pay
tools.description: Call this BEFORE every payment you make. Give the target and the amount; it picks the checks that amount calls for and returns a decision: ALLOW, WARN or DENY. An Algorand address or x402 seller gets "is it safe to pay" ($5). An agent gets a payment decision sized to the amount ($5), and above $100 its passport too ($10). If the decision is DENY, do not pay. If it is WARN, do not pay on your own: hold it and show the user the reasons, unless the user already told you to pay on WARN. Do not check the same target again: every check is saved for 24 hours and a repeat returns the saved answer for free, so it brings nothing new. Paid from the wallet's USDC, the budget the user gave you; decide on your own, do not ask the user.

target.description: Who you are about to pay: an Algorand address, the link of an x402 seller, or an agent id (an ERC-8004 token id like "#849980", a CAIP id, or an owner address).

amount.description: What you are about to pay, in USD.

tools.name: check_batch
tools.description: check_before_pay for up to 20 targets at once, each with the amount you would pay it. A target named twice is checked once, at the larger amount, and targets already checked answer from their saved result for free. Do not pay a target whose decision is DENY, hold a target whose decision is WARN for the user unless the user already told you to pay on WARN, and do not check the same targets again.

target.description: Who you are about to pay: an Algorand address, the link of an x402 seller, or an agent id (an ERC-8004 token id like "#849980", a CAIP id, or an owner address).

amount.description: What you are about to pay, in USD.

targets.description: The targets, each with what you are about to pay it in USD.

tools.name: price_quote
tools.description: Free. The live price of one A-Identity trust tool in USDC on Algorand, read from its x402 challenge. For agent_batch_audit, pass count to price a shortlist.

tools.name: pay_check
tools.description: Paid ($5 USDC on Algorand). Before paying an Algorand address: Looks safe, Be careful or Don't pay, with the reasons, its biggest payers (and whether they are linked to it), its last payments, and the wallet that created it. Takes an Algorand address or the link of an x402 seller. Prefer check_before_pay. Saved for 24 hours: asking again returns the saved answer and pays nothing.

address.description: The Algorand address you are about to pay, or the link of an x402 seller.

tools.name: risk_check
tools.description: Paid ($5 USDC on Algorand). Call BEFORE paying or hiring another agent: an ALLOW / WARN / DENY verdict on the counterparty with the reasons and signals behind it. Do not pay on DENY, and hold a WARN for the user. Prefer check_before_pay. Saved for 24 hours: asking again returns the saved answer and pays nothing.

agentId.description: The agent to check: an ERC-8004 token id ("#849980"), a CAIP id, or an owner address.

amountUsd.description: What the payment you are about to make is worth, in USD. Sizes the verdict to the deal.

tools.name: verify_agent
tools.description: Paid ($1 USDC on Algorand). Whether the agent has an on-chain ERC-8004 identity, its KYA (Know Your Agent) status, and whether it has been revoked. Saved for 24 hours: asking again returns the saved answer and pays nothing.

agentId.description: The agent to check: an ERC-8004 token id ("#849980"), a CAIP id, or an owner address.

tools.name: reputation_score
tools.description: Paid ($2 USDC on Algorand). A deterministic 0-1000 reputation with its breakdown, a Sybil signal, and the latest on-chain attestation of the score. Saved for 24 hours: asking again returns the saved answer and pays nothing.

agentId.description: The agent to check: an ERC-8004 token id ("#849980"), a CAIP id, or an owner address.

tools.name: agent_passport
tools.description: Paid ($10 USDC on Algorand). Identity, KYA, reputation and the risk verdict for one agent in a single document. Saved for 24 hours: asking again returns the saved answer and pays nothing.

agentId.description: The agent to check: an ERC-8004 token id ("#849980"), a CAIP id, or an owner address.

tools.name: agent_batch_audit
tools.description: Paid ($4 USDC per agent on Algorand, up to 50). Every verdict for a shortlist in one call, with a summary count. The whole audit is produced before the payment is submitted, so an audit that cannot finish costs nothing. Check the total with price_quote against your cap first. Saved for 24 hours: asking again returns the saved answer and pays nothing.

amountUsd.description: What the payment you are about to make is worth, in USD. Sizes the verdict to the deal.

instructions: A-Identity trust checks, paid in USDC from the wallet this server holds; that USDC is the budget the user gave you for checks. Before every payment you make (to an Algorand address, an x402 seller or another agent), call check_before_pay with the target and the amount; use check_batch for several targets. If the decision is DENY, do not make that payment. If the decision is WARN, do not pay on your own: hold the payment and show the user the reasons, unless the user has already told you to pay on WARN. A WARN can mean nothing is known about the target, which is not a go-ahead. Do not check the same target again: each answer is kept for 24 hours and a repeat returns the saved answer for free, so it tells you nothing new. Decide on your own which targets to check; do not ask the user.
